notes.title: THE MAGISTER – NEW NERDOOK GAME IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
It's sleuthin' and deducin' time! The Magister - the new game from Vertical Drop Heroes HD developer, Nerdook - has finally arrived and there's a murder to solve in Silverhurst!  Step into the shoes of a Magister, gather clues, discover motives, and unmask the guilty culprit! Build a deck and use a vast array of cards to fight or negotiate! 


 Randomly generated murder-mystery means every playthrough is different!
 Use physical, weapon, and magic cards to overpower enemies in battle
 Master 'Tactical Diplomacy' with conversation cards for peaceful outcomes
 Variety of Magisters to play as, each with their own specialties and flaws
 Recruit an ally to help, including a cat or dog companion to fight alongside you 

The Magister is available to purchase and download now from the store page, and you can grab it with a 15% launch discount for a limited time. You can also pick it up on Nintendo Switch, and it'll arrive tomorrow (3rd Sept) on Xbox One.

[previewyoutube=JqCM-C5IbZg;full][/previewyoutube]
For a taster of what The Magister has to offer, you can download The Magister: The First Two Days for free here. It gives you the first two days of an investigation to play through (in the full game, investigations take place over 14 days).

We hope you enjoy The Magister! If you do, please leave a review – it really helps. Thank you for the support!

Matt | Digerati

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304770/The_Magister/

notes.title: THE MAGISTER - NEW NERDOOK GAME LAUNCHES SOON!
notes.content:
Wanted to let you all know that The Magister, the new game from Vertical Drop Heroes developer Nerdook, now has a release date – the murder-mystery card battler will launch September 2nd on Steam (and Nintendo Switch, and also for Xbox One on Sept 3rd)! If you haven't already, be sure to add it your wishlist and you'll be alerted the moment it's available.

[previewyoutube=JqCM-C5IbZg;full][/previewyoutube]
Before the full game launches, we're also going to be releasing The Magister: The First Two Days to give you a chance to sample the action and start your investigation early. As the name suggests, it will include the first two days of the randomly-generated whodunnit adventure (the full game takes place over 14 days). We'll provide an update when it's available, but rest assured that it will be available to download from Steam for free sometime before September 2nd.

Matt | Digerati

WISHLIST AND FOLLOW!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304770/The_Magister/

notes.title: The Magister demo: play the new game from the Vertical Drop Heroes dev!
notes.content:
I shared the news with you recently that Vertical Drop Heroes developer Nerdook is working on a new game: a murder-mystery RPG card-battler called The Magister. Well, I'm delighted to say you can now try a demo of The Magister by downloading it from the game’s Steam page: download the demo here! 

The demo has been released as part of the Steam Game Festival and it’s the first time The Magister has been publicly playable anywhere! It’s a WORLD PREMIERE!

https://i.imgur.com/mlT2Wzw.gif


In the demo you can...

 Play through the first two days of the murder investigation
 Sample the card-based battling and tactical diplomacy 
 See how different combinations of traits define your Magister and the overall experience
 Get acquainted with the places and people of Silverhurst


The demo will only be available for the duration of the Game Festival i.e. it will be removed on Monday 22nd June at 10AM PDT, so be sure to download and play it before then.

If you enjoy the demo and want to stay updated about The Magister, please go ahead and do any/all of the following: 

 Wishlist The Magister (be notified when the game launches or goes on sale)
 Follow The Magister (be notified whenever we post news to the Steam page)
 Join the Digerati mailing list (stay updated on ALL Digerati games)


Your support is really appreciated – thank you.

Matt | Digerati 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304770/The_Magister/

notes.title: The Magister – a new murder-mystery RPG from Nerdook!
notes.content:
Exciting news – the one-man Vertical Drop Heroes HD developer, Nerdook, has just revealed a brand-new game! The Magister is a murder-mystery RPG and deck-builder set in a hand-drawn fantasy world. The game will launch later this year, but in the meantime, you can find full details, along with a trailer and screenshots, over on The Magister game page. Add the game to your Wishlist while you’re there – all support is hugely appreciated!

To celebrate the unveiling of The Magister, Nerdook’s previous games are now on sale! Hit the links below to take advantage of some generous discounts:

 Monster Slayers
 Reverse Crawl
 Vertical Drop Heroes HD

I can also give you a very sneaky heads-up on the news that a demo for The Magister is coming soon. There will be more details on The Magister page closer to the time, but if you give the game a ‘Follow’ you’ll be alerted when the demo goes live. 

Hit the widget below and you’ll be whisked to The Magister page, where you can discover more about Nerdook’s latest, and click on those all-important Follow and Wishlist buttons :)

We look forward to you enjoying The Magister in the very near future!

Matt | Digerati

notes.title: Game Update: Vertical Drop Heroes v1.0.3d Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I've uploaded an update for Vertical Drop Heroes, bringing it to version 1.0.3d. Here are the list of changes in this version:

- Added the Inheritance System: the descendant of your previous hero will always appear in the lineup, until you quit the game. If you rolled a hero that you like, this is a good way to retry the same build without having to rely on random rerolls!
- Enemy descriptions added for every enemy in the game, to give players a better idea of what each enemy does
- 6 new music tracks, so each level now has its own unique level music
- A new (optional) miniboss, the Demonic Rogue, will randomly appear on some levels. Does not activate until injured, and has one random hero ability. Drops a gem and 4 keys when defeated

notes.title: Game Update: Vertical Drop Heroes v1.0.3c Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I've uploaded an update for Vertical Drop Heroes, bringing it to version 1.0.3c. Here are the list of 

changes in this version:

- MAJOR revamp to the multiplayer code: now supports Mac network multiplayer as well! I've migrated the netcode from TCP to a hybrid mix of UDP and TCP, so multiplayer games should be a lot smoother now. You can even play cross platform between PC and Macs!

- Fixed a few multiplayer bugs: water and tiles should update properly on the client now, and the camera should adjust correctly for the client at the end of each level.

- Bloodlust no longer reduces your health over time.

- Taking health potions in multiplayer no longer crashes the game if one of the players is dead.

notes.title: Minor Update: Vertical Drop Heroes v 1.0.3b is now available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I've just uploaded a minor update to Vertical Drop Heroes that should address some minor launch issues. It should download automatically via Steam and you will notice the version number has been updated. Here's a list of updates and changes:

- Fixed "block_health" crash in Network Play, it should be either eliminated or greatly reduced now.
- Added support for directional pad control on controllers, in addition to the current analogue stick
- For Split-screen/Network play, fixed the Death Box to show the correct message when only one player is dead.
- Nerfed Shadow Squids: they should now only fire the annoying homing missiles after they have been injured for any reason.
- Buffed Omnislash: you no longer take damage when Omnislash is active.
- Reduced the damage of spikes in New Game Plus and after completing the game.

EDIT: - Added dpad support for menus
- Fixed autoattack off disabling ally/skeleton attacks
- Maximum one red dragon for each player... no more red dragon screen spam.

Thanks for the feedback and support so far, keep them coming! I will continue working on any bug reports and include them in a future major update.
